facts.fact: The Attorney General's August 2022 investigation found 8,690 citizens drawing salaries under national numbers that do not exist in the civil registry system, showing public payroll is keyed on the national number.

The Attorney General's August 2022 investigation reported 88,819 incorrect national numbers, including 63,986 forged numbers absent from the civil registry system and 8,690 people paid salaries under such numbers.

systems.system: unified electronic national number system (civil status authority)
